Subject: Orchard Health renewal kickoff — capacity uplift, term option, and QBR cadence

Hi Alyssa / Marco,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier this week — excited to kick off the renewal conversation. Per our call, Orchard is targeting a 12–18 month renewal that includes: a 20% baseline capacity uplift, optional burst credits for seasonal spikes, and the ability to activate private region isolation for PHI workloads.

Goals for this thread:
- Confirm stakeholders and procurement timeline
- Lock a QBR window for a renewal review + exec readout
- Share a strawman mutual action plan and term options

Proposed next steps:
1) Alyssa/Marco — confirm latest headcount/staffing dates that map to expected token usage by Dec 3
2) Connor/Marissa — we’ll share a one-page MA P + pricing ladder by end of day Monday (attached)
3) Procurement — please share preferred contract lead and any procurement windows (PO timing)
4) Schedule a 60-min QBR week of Nov 30 or Dec 7 to review terms + SLAs

I attached a draft MA P and a proposed QBR agenda to get the ball rolling. I’m free Mon/Tue afternoons next week for a short alignment call if you want to walk through the pricing ladder before the QBR.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth renewal.

Best,

- Timeline: Procurement has an internal review week of Dec 13, but we'd like to have commercial terms and SOW by EOD Dec 7 to give them runway.
- Capacity: 20% uplift sounds right; we may want a soft cap increase for our holiday peak (Jan 15 - Feb 5) — can you include burst credits in the ladder?
